import React, { useState } from 'react'; import { Box, Paper, Typography, TextField, Button, Grid, Container, Alert, Snackbar, Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableContainer, TableHead, TableRow } from '@mui/material'; import axios from 'axios'; function CostCalculator() { const [formData, setFormData] = useState({ scale: { consumers_per_tenant: 3, total_tenants: 5000, endpoints_per_tenant: 10000 }, cloud_provider: 'aws' }); const [costBreakdown, setCostBreakdown] = useState(null); const [notification, setNotification] = useState({ open: false, message: '', severity: 'success' }); const handleInputChange = (field, value) => { setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, scale: { ...prev.scale, [field]: parseInt(value) || 0 } })); }; const calculateCosts = async () => { try { const response = await axios.post('http://localhost:8000/calculate-cost', formData); setCostBreakdown(response.data); setNotification({ open: true, message: 'Cost calculation successful!', severity: 'success' }); } catch (error) { setNotification({ open: true, message: 'Error calculating costs: ' + (error.response?.data?.detail || error.message), severity: 'error' }); } }; const handleCloseNotification = () => { setNotification({ ...notification, open: false }); }; const formatCurrency = (value) => { return `$${value.toFixed(2)}`; }; return ( PxGrid Cloud Cost Calculator Scale Parameters S.No Scale Parameters Count 1 Cloud consumer per Tenant handleInputChange('consumers_per_tenant', e.target.value)} size="small" inputProps={{ min: 1 }} /> 2 Total Tenant handleInputChange('total_tenants', e.target.value)} size="small" inputProps={{ min: 1 }} /> 3 Total End-points per Tenant handleInputChange('endpoints_per_tenant', e.target.value)} size="small" inputProps={{ min: 1 }} />
{costBreakdown && ( Network Load Metrics Metric Per Consumer Total (All Tenants) API Calls 189 calls/day {(189 * formData.scale.consumers_per_tenant * formData.scale.total_tenants).toLocaleString()} calls/day API Data Size 1.076 MB/request {((189 * 1.076 * formData.scale.consumers_per_tenant * formData.scale.total_tenants) / 1024).toFixed(2)} GB/day Message Events 100,010 events/day {(100010 * formData.scale.consumers_per_tenant * formData.scale.total_tenants).toLocaleString()} events/day Message Data Size 1 KB/message {((100010 * formData.scale.consumers_per_tenant * formData.scale.total_tenants) / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(2)} GB/day
Cost Breakdown (Monthly) PxGrid Costs {formatCurrency(costBreakdown.breakdown.pxgrid_cost)} Storage Costs DynamoDB: {formatCurrency(costBreakdown.breakdown.storage.dynamodb_cost)} S3: {formatCurrency(costBreakdown.breakdown.storage.s3_cost)} Container Costs {formatCurrency(costBreakdown.breakdown.container_cost)} Network Costs Throughput: {formatCurrency(costBreakdown.breakdown.network.throughput_cost)} MSK: {formatCurrency(costBreakdown.breakdown.network.msk_cost)} Total Monthly Cost: {formatCurrency(costBreakdown.total_cost)} Cost per Tenant: {formatCurrency(costBreakdown.monthly_cost_per_tenant)} )} {notification.message} ); } export default CostCalculator;
